name: S. D. International Limited
industry: Packaging / Semi-rigid and rigid food packaging
description: We are engaged in the manufacturing of semi-rigid and rigid food packaging products in India, serving end-use segments including takeaway food service, dairy, sweets and confectionery, bakery, branded food products, and agro-based produce. Our customer base comprises business-to-business (B2B) customers, corporates, and distributors across India, with an aggregate manufacturing capacity of 20,100 MT.

objects.purpose: Repayment/prepayment, in full or in part, of certain borrowings availed by our Company
Funding of capital expenditure towards purchase of machinery and equipment by our Company

top_risks: We derive a significant portion of our revenue from operations from our top 10 customers (27.15%, 30.63%, and 35.44% in Fiscals 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively), and the loss of any key customer could adversely affect our business.
We have significant dependence on our top suppliers for the supply of our principal raw materials, and any disruption or price volatility could affect our profit margins.
Our continued operations at our manufacturing facilities are critical to our business, and any disruption, shutdown, or under-utilization could materially affect our financial condition.
